关于 P Chat 的疑问，在这里找到答案。
en_US: Answers to common questions about P Chat.

zh_CN: 不需要。P Chat 无账号、无密码，打开即用。故事、角色与配置全部保存在设备本地，卸载即彻底删除。
en_US: No. P Chat has no accounts and no passwords — open it and play. Stories, characters and settings all stay on your device, and uninstalling removes everything.

zh_CN: 我的 API Key 安全吗？
安全。Key 使用 iOS Keychain 加密存储，仅保存在你的设备上。对话请求由设备直连你配置的服务商，我们没有任何中间服务器。你还可以在设置中一键关闭全部网络请求。
en_US: Yes. Keys are encrypted in the iOS Keychain and stay on your device. Chat requests go straight from your device to the providers you configured — we run no middle servers. You can also switch off all network access with one toggle.

zh_CN: 支持哪些 AI 模型？
内置 DeepSeek、OpenAI、Anthropic Claude、Google Gemini、xAI Grok 与豆包（火山方舟）预设，也支持任何 OpenAI 兼容的自定义接口；每个服务商可维护自己的模型列表，并支持深度思考（推理）模式。
en_US: Built-in presets for DeepSeek, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, xAI Grok and Doubao (Volcano Ark), plus any OpenAI-compatible custom endpoint. Each provider keeps its own model list, with deep-reasoning modes supported.

zh_CN: 故事模式和群聊角色扮演有什么区别？
en_US: Story Mode vs. group roleplay — what's the difference?

zh_CN: 故事模式：由「故事导演」AI 逐幕推进的单人剧情，你以角色身份回应，也能切换为导演旁白。
en_US: Story Mode: a single-player tale paced by the AI “Story Director”. You reply as your character, or switch to director narration.

zh_CN: 群聊演绎：最多 8 位角色同台，五种发言策略决定谁接话，适合多人互动的长线剧情。
en_US: Group Roleplay: up to 8 characters on stage with five speaking strategies deciding who talks next — great for long, multi-character plots.

zh_CN: App 会自动生成前情摘要，你也可以维护长期记忆列表并一键总结。这样即使故事很长、超出上下文窗口，角色依然记得重要的事。
en_US: The app auto-generates recaps of earlier events, and you can curate a long-term memory list with one-tap summaries. Even when a story outgrows the context window, characters keep remembering what matters.
How do I delete my data?

zh_CN: 设置中提供本机数据统计与一键清空；删除单个故事或角色也会同步清理其数据。卸载 App 即彻底删除全部内容。
en_US: Settings include on-device data stats and a one-tap erase; deleting a story or character clears its data too. Uninstalling the app removes everything.
